product_metadata.title: Purity Home Soft & Light Weight 100% Combed Compact Cotton Sheet Set, 4 Piece Set, Bedding Queen Sheets Percale Weave, Cool & Breathable, Moisture Wicking, Fitted Sheet Fits Upto 18" Deep Pocket,Ivory
features: 100% Combed Compact Cotton - Percale Weave. This product is developed and designed, to keep it light weight for extra air permeability, air-flow movement and moisture wicking. This ultra-light fabric construction provides more comfort and softness during sleep.

CLASSIC TAILORED SET INCLUDES: QUEEN Set includes a 92 x 102 inches flat Sheet, 60 x 80 + 16 inches fitted Sheet, and 2 Standard Pillowcases of 20 x 30 inches. The fitted sheet fits mattresses up to 18 inches.

LUXURY SHEET SET & EXCELLENT CRAFTSMANSHIP: Beautifully crafted from 100-percent long staple cotton, this luxurious sheet set will turn your bed into a haven. Woven from the finest cotton fibers this sheet set allows you to relax into its cool comfort. Meticulous craftsmanship and expertly woven to produce super soft luxurious feel. Special finishing process to accentuate the softness of the fabric. High quality color dyes for safety & long lasting color fastness.

CERTIFICATION: Made in a vertically integrated factory certified for ISO-9001:2008, ISO-14001:2004 & ISO-18001:2007. SEDEX, OEKO-TEX and BSCI. We believe in delivering nothing less than the best quality for our customers.

YOUR TRUST - OUR ASSURANCE: Each piece is individually inspected for defect free product. A class of Elegant rich quality Cotton Sheet Set which can be used for the Master Bedroom, Charming Guest room, Hotel Suite Room and even Hospital Room; Available at a very reasonable price. Machine wash, Do not bleach, Do not dry clean, Tumble dry normal, Iron medium, Dry in shade.

details.Product Care Instructions: Do Not Dry Clean, Do Not Bleach, Tumble Dry
